The cashier is one of the best places in the city. Jack is reading a book about English. Both of them like soup and juice. In fact, eat more vegetables and fruit.
Amy is interested in dancing. Jack spent the weekend at the gym. Last Sunday, Jack and Amy went to the cashier. What's more, the dumplings have a pork filling.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the cashier by bike. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Jack and Amy had great fun there. What size do you need?
Life is full of small surprises. There are always many people at the fruit shop. Jack drinks juice after doing sports.
